question: Does limited agency cast away wrong action without ego union?
premises: Without ego union, limited agency casts away.
Even with contraction, wrong action is not thus.
Some own action is intentionally held.
inference: Limited agency removes wrong action only when ego union is absent.
uncertainties: Sandhi splitting of sasaṃkoco@pi and so@kalaḥ is interpretive.
plain_english: Without ego union, limited agency casts away; even with contraction, wrong action is not thus, nor is some own action intentionally held.
